title: Better Vanilla 456
description: This project is a alternate version of Better Vanilla 123
body:
Better Vanilla 456 is an alternate version of Better Vanilla 123. Better Vanilla 123 is a vanilla plus modpack while Better Vanilla 456 is a vanilla plus modpack too but it isn't that packed with mods. It'll most likely be optimization mods and some little quality of life mods.
It has the notes mod which makes it that you can write notes like coordinates. And alot of optimization mods and bobby mod to increase render distance above the max game limit. And it has nvidium which only works on newer graphic cards that supports mesh shaders and if you have that graphic card you will get a fps boost it doesnt work with shaders but has good fps while using bobby for the render distance. There are more mods coming soon!
